items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: He -- I didn't know Buster in Memphis, to be frank with you.

ctx.x: Well, let's go -- like, again, when you were in the service, when you started playing in the service, did you start reading (out of drumbooks then) (inaudible) or --
Oh, yes. That's when that other drummer by the name of Buster, he was a West Indian boy, big, strong rascal, he bet those -- that practice pad, down at the bottom of those little --
The supports to hold the legs?
